# PTx Trimble FarmENGAGE Data API

- **Product:** PTx Trimble FarmENGAGE Data API (Agriculture (PTx Trimble) family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** not declared in the definition; see the developer guide. Declared security schemes: none declared.
- **Access:** PTx Trimble developer programme (agdeveloper.trimble.com now redirects to ptxag.com).
- **To call it you would need:** PTx Trimble (FarmENGAGE) API credentials for https://api.farmengage.com/prod/externalApi/3.0.
- **Documented servers:** `https://api.farmengage.com/prod/externalApi/3.0`.
- **Definition:** [ptx-farmengage](https://api-docs.farmengage.com/swagger.json) (FarmENGAGE Data API - Developer Guide, version v September 2026). Documentation: https://api-docs.farmengage.com/.
